title: Pod disk gate counts an interrupted install's leftovers as used space
description: An install killed mid-download (Pod stop, crash) leaves its partial on the volume: aria2 writes <dest>.part, the Hugging Face path stages into <dest>.part.hfstage/. The wrapper's du counts those bytes as used, so the remote disk-full gate refuses the retry for space the retry would reclaim (live 2026-08-10: need 13.3 GB, have 12.0 GB free, for the very dep whose 13.3 GB .part filled the volume). Nothing reclaims .hfstage either: uninstall answers already-absent and the orphan sweep cannot map a staging path to a dep. Facts and measurements: docs/download-manager.md, the HF staging section. Related: MPI-752 (gate bills only known-missing bytes).
